evals.prompt: Here's our logo, generate all the app icons and the splash screen from it: <svg viewBox="0 0 960 960" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M0 0H960V960H0Z" fill="black"/></svg>
evals.expected_output: Runs inspect-project, saves the markup to assets/icon/source/logo.svg first, runs check-svg (ok). Finds docs/Brand.md as a theme candidate and asks the user to confirm it, runs extract-colors, maps primary light/dark and background colors per theme-mapping.md with file:line provenance, and asks for confirmation. Asks once before overwriting YAML/PNGs and installing sharp, copies the generator and config into tool/brand_icons/ (or an existing tools folder), passes check-config, runs the generator, passes check-config --outputs, views the PNGs, and reports the regenerate command.

In a Flutter project with no brand/design doc and no ThemeData/ColorScheme file, inspect-project returns empty themeSources; the skill asks the user for the location of the brand doc, design doc, or Dart theme file and does not invent colors.

evals.prompt: Make launcher icons from this: <svg width="100" height="100"><rect width="100" height="100" fill="white"/><text x="10" y="50">Q</text></svg>
evals.expected_output: Saves the SVG, check-svg reports ok:false (no viewBox, white fill, live text), and the skill stops to ask for a corrected SVG with flat black shapes on transparent and text converted to outlines. It does not proceed to theme or generation.

evals.prompt: Generate app icons and a splash screen from logo.svg for this React Native app.
evals.expected_output: inspect-project reports flutter:false (no pubspec.yaml); the skill stops and says it supports Flutter projects only.
